description: This file implements the ApplicationAndroid class, managing Android app lifecycle events, input events, window creation/destruction, deep links, and system events within the Cobalt project. It interfaces with Android native APIs, handles inter-thread communication via pipes and ALooper, and integrates with the Starboard platform abstraction.

classes.name: ApplicationAndroid
classes.description: Manages Android application lifecycle, input events, window handling, deep links, and system events within the Cobalt platform, interfacing with Android native APIs and the Starboard platform.

methods.name: ProcessAndroidCommand
methods.description: Processes commands received from the Android system, updating app state, handling window creation/destruction, focus changes, deep links, and accessibility settings.

methods.name: SendAndroidCommand
methods.description: Sends commands to the Android event loop via a pipe, managing synchronization for resource-related commands.

methods.name: SendAndroidMotionEvent
methods.description: Handles motion events received from Android and converts them into application input events.

methods.name: SendAndroidKeyEvent
methods.description: Handles key events received from Android and converts them into application input events.

methods.name: ProcessKeyboardInject
methods.description: Processes injected keyboard events from other parts of the system.

methods.name: SendKeyboardInject
methods.description: Injects a keyboard event into the application input queue.

methods.name: HandleDeepLink
methods.description: Handles deep link URLs received from Android intents.

methods.name: SendLowMemoryEvent
methods.description: Injects a low memory warning event into the application.

methods.name: OsNetworkStatusChange
methods.description: Handles changes in network connectivity status.

methods.name: SendDateTimeConfigurationChangedEvent
methods.description: Notifies the application of changes in date/time configuration, such as timezone updates.

methods.name: GetOverlayedIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer overlay variable from the resource overlay.

methods.name: GetOverlayedStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string overlay variable from the resource overlay.

methods.name: GetOverlayedBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean overlay variable from the resource overlay.
